target.description: Compiler target and target-specific standard library.

architecture.description: Compilation architecture used by compile-time target queries and target-specific intrinsics.

cpuFeatures.description: Explicit CPU features. SIMD remains scalar unless simd128 is selected.

modules.description: Exact repository-backed source modules. Build and check never access the network.

selector.description: Commit, tag, or branch resolved to an exact lock revision.

noRecursion.description: Reject recursion and calls whose possible targets cannot be closed statically in every reachable method.

panicPolicy.description: ESP-IDF fatal-panic terminal policy. The halt policy requires CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_PANIC_PRINT_HALT=y.

sources.description: Source globs relative to this manifest.

exclude.description: Source globs removed after the sources patterns are evaluated.

freestanding.description: GNU/ELF freestanding linker and native inputs.

cosmopolitan.description: Cosmopolitan Libc runtime selection for x86-64 APE builds.

generatedC.description: Generated C path relative to the project directory.

generatedHeader.description: Generated native header path relative to the project directory.

cLayout.description: Generated C layout. Modular output partitions reachable definitions by stable source identity after whole-program optimization.

generatedDirectory.description: Generated modular bundle directory relative to the project directory.

symbolMap.description: Optional generated JSON symbol-map path relative to the project directory.

lto.description: Enable hosted or Cosmopolitan link-time optimization. Requires Release configuration.

configuration.description: Hosted or Cosmopolitan native build configuration.

compiler.description: Hosted compiler, or the x86_64-unknown-cosmo-cc wrapper for Cosmopolitan projects.

executable.description: Hosted executable or Cosmopolitan APE path relative to the project directory.

image.description: Freestanding ELF image path relative to the project directory.

espIdfProjectDirectory.description: ESP-IDF project directory relative to the C~ project directory.

run.description: Optional rebuild-and-run process settings used by ctilde --run and the VS Code Run Project command.

executor.description: Run directly on the host or through wsl --exec. WSL execution is available only from Windows.

command.description: PATH command or project-relative executable. Hosted and Cosmopolitan projects default to their built output.

args.description: Arguments passed without shell parsing. Supports ${projectRoot} and ${buildOutput}.

successExitCodes.description: Process exit codes treated as a successful run.
